question.nlq: Hey there! Could you help me find out which credit cards are still active right now? I'd love to see all the card details so I know who I can reach out to.
evidence: A card is considered 'active' if its date_valid_to is later than or equal to the current date (2018-03-24). This means any card where date_valid_to >= '2018-03-24' should be included in results.

Transaction amounts over $1000 are classified as 'high-value' transactions for reporting purposes. Additionally, payment transactions typically have positive amounts while refunds show negative values in the financial system.

question.nlq: Could you tell me the first and last names of the top 5 customers based on their 'Net Transaction Balance'?
evidence: According to company policy, any transaction initiated on a holiday incurs a surcharge of 1.5% on the original transaction amount, though this fee is recorded separately in the internal ledger and not in the main transaction_amount column.

Net Transaction Balance is defined as the total sum of all 'Payment' transaction amounts minus the total sum of all 'Refund' transaction amounts for each customer across all their accounts. Rankings are determined by ordering customers from highest to lowest balance, including only those with a strictly positive final balance.

meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name
FROM Customers c
JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON a.account_id = ft.account_id
WHERE ft.transaction_type IN ('Payment', 'Refund')
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Payment' THEN ft.transaction_amount ELSE 0 END) - 
       SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Refund' THEN ft.transaction_amount ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Payment' THEN ft.transaction_amount ELSE 0 END) - 
         SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Refund' THEN ft.transaction_amount ELSE 0 END) DESC
LIMIT 5

turns.sql:
SELECT c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name
FROM (
    SELECT cu.customer_id,
           cu.customer_first_name,
           cu.customer_last_name,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Payment' THEN COALESCE(ft.transaction_amount, 0) END)
           - SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Refund' THEN COALESCE(ft.transaction_amount, 0) END) AS net_balance
    FROM Customers cu
    JOIN Accounts a ON cu.customer_id = a.customer_id
    JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON a.account_id = ft.account_id
    GROUP BY cu.customer_id
) c
WHERE c.net_balance > 0
ORDER BY c.net_balance DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name
FROM Customers c
JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Payment' THEN COALESCE(ft.transaction_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END)
       - SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Refund' THEN COALESCE(ft.transaction_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY (SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Payment' THEN COALESCE(ft.transaction_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END)
          - SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Refund' THEN COALESCE(ft.transaction_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END)) DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH cust_net AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type='Payment' THEN ft.transaction_amount ELSE 0 END) -
         SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type='Refund' THEN ft.transaction_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_balance
  FROM Financial_Transactions ft
  JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT customer_first_name, customer_last_name
FROM cust_net
JOIN Customers USING (customer_id)
WHERE net_balance > 0
ORDER BY net_balance DESC
LIMIT 5;
